title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.06.1
notes:
- Lemon EQ keeps its analyzer refreshing during continuous mouse movement. Timed spectrum analysis, smoother peak drawing and reduced redraw work improve display responsiveness.
- Lemon EQ adds an accessible analyzer Speed menu with resolution, range, tilt and averaging choices. New instances use a slower display; saved analyzer preferences are retained.
- Clearer audition, dynamics and A/B controls, plus optional temporary RMS Level match for comparing EQ changes. Level match is off by default and clears when the editor closes.
- Full-length Playlist pattern clips follow added or deleted Piano Roll notes across arrangements, including Undo and Redo. Manually trimmed and stretched clip lengths are preserved.
- Reversed Lemon Sampler audio is drawn in reverse in the Playlist without modifying the source recording.
- Reset all selected Mixer faders to 0 dB together, and solo selected Mixer tracks from their context menu.
- Selected Playlist track headers support group delete, solo and color changes. Deleting selected folder headers preserves unselected child tracks and supports Undo.
- Drag multiple selected effects from Plugin Picker onto a Mixer channel in picker order. Existing effects and reserved slots are preserved; drops with insufficient room are rejected together.
- Playlist clip-control category buttons remain visible when clicked repeatedly. Audio clip menu icons show a pointing-finger cursor.
- FL project sample recovery handles collected content placeholders without an FL content folder. More-specific relative paths take priority, while duplicate sample names require an explicit choice.
- The first normal Save of a newly imported FLP opens Save As for a Lemon working copy. File > Import adds a persistent compatibility report, full report export and missing-file recovery choices.
- FL plugin substitutes require approval before starting with default settings. Untouched imported presets are retained, deliberate native-plugin edits save correctly, and state-normalization warnings remain in the import report.
- Imported FL Mixer tracks use neutral layouts while saved Lemon layouts are preserved. Edited duplicate effect-control records update consistently.
- The import report identifies unsupported automation links while retaining their data. Older FL project layouts and unidentified automation targets remain compatibility limitations.
